name: Integration Readiness Review
description: Review of your current ERP and embedded integrations, a gap list, a prioritized roadmap and a partner validation plan.

name: Deal Desk Sprint
description: Discovery and solution design on up to 3 enterprise deals, plus a reusable RFP and security-questionnaire library.

name: AI Agent Pilot
description: One agent taken from scope to production for a finance or sales team, a usage dashboard and a handover session.

name: Partner Program Launch
description: Program design (tiers, benefits, partner economics), a certification curriculum, a co-sell playbook and the first 2 partners onboarded.

name: Ongoing advisory
description: A call every two weeks, async review of plans and specs, and help on partner and deal escalations.
